title: Pricing Page
concept: Lowmoss Mushroom Farm: a weekly harvest-share pricing page grown in a railway tunnel, with a monthly/yearly toggle, three plans (Spore, Flush recommended on a lilac tint, Cellar) priced by one value metric — fresh kilos a week — then member proof, a grouped comparison, a plain Q/A FAQ with FAQPage schema and a wholesale last mile.
notes: No dependencies. Billing control is a native radio pair (keyboard and screen-reader ready); yearly = 10 months for 12 and the per-kilo price updates with it. Plans stack with the recommended plan first under 860px; the comparison matrix restacks per row on phones instead of scrolling sideways. Reduced motion drops the price swap animation and smooth scroll.
